messages:
Devin: Heads up — gcu-node-42 (g4-203) is spitting Xid 79s during the nightly soak. Seeing ECC counter creep on GPU3. Want to reproduce and hold the node until we validate.

Devin: Logs snippet:
```\n2026-03-11T02:12:09Z ERROR nvml: Xid 79 GPU 3
2026-03-11T02:12:09Z WARN ecc: correctable_errors: gpu3=12
2026-03-11T02:12:09Z INFO kernel: pci_rescan triggered for 0000:65:00.0
```

Maria: Ugh. Was this the same card that failed earlier in rack rack-7? Names look like g4-203 but could be a swap.

Akshay: IIRC we replaced the heatsink on 4/3 — could be a seating issue. Suggest run: `sudo ./soakbench-slim --node gcu-node-42 --gpu 3 --pattern memrw --duration 2h --log-level debug` to reproduce quickly.

Janet Ops: Marking node out of rotation now. @sre-bot can you drain + remove from autoscaler pool? We need to avoid user jobs landing mid-triage :pray:

sre-bot: ack — draining gcu-node-42, evicting noncritical pods, moving node to quarantine pool. ETA 2m. :robot_face:

Devin: Thanks. I'll kick off a short targeted run first, then a thermal cycle (fan profile + 30m idle) and then a longer 6h soak if we see repro.

gpu-bench-bot: queued job `soak-slim-1764509876` -> assigned gcu-node-42:gpu3, live logs at https://bench.internal/jobs/1764509876

Maria: Quick checklist before heavy runs:
- reseat GPU (power down)
- nvbios and firmware versions match (run `nvidia-smi -q | grep -A2 BIOS`)
- check PCIe link speed (`lspci -vv -s 65:00.0 | grep LnkSta`)

Akshay: Also run `memtestG80` and `stress-ng --gpu 0 --timeout 30m` in the lab jig if repro is flaky here. If we can’t repro, send to bench for extended 72h soak.

Devin: Kicked off `soakbench-slim` now. Early log shows repeated soft ECC correctables during high memrw bursts.

Devin: Command I used:
```bash
sudo ./soakbench-slim --node gcu-node-42 --gpu 3 --pattern memrw --batch-size 8 --duration 120m --collect nvml,thermal,pcie
```

Janet Ops: Capacity check — if you hold this node for 72h, we dip into reserved capacity for the east prod pool. Approving hold but watch costs. Ping me if we need hot-swap.

Maria: After one thermal cycle (power off 10m) I saw ECC stops increasing but Xid still popped once on resume. That suggests intermittent after resume.

Akshay: Could be power sequencing at PCIe riser. If seat + reseat + firmware don't help, we should test on a different riser slot in lab to isolate.

Devin: Re-ran with `--pcie-reset` option; Xid still repros at ~+90m mark. Attaching last 30s of nvml output:
```\n[1764509975] GPU3 ECC correctable +1
[1764509975] Xid [79] 00000000: GPU hang detected
[1764509976] nvml: resetting pcie slot 0000:65:00.0
```

sre-bot: Noted. Creating a return ticket for hardware team if bench can't reproduce within next 12h: RT-2026-298.

Janet Ops: If hardware team takes it, we should decide whether to RMA or keep for further debug. Prefer RMA if it fails >3 times across different slots.

Devin: Current plan:
1) replicate in lab on bench jig (Akshay)
2) if repro on bench -> extended 72h soak in bench with thermal cycling
3) if non-repro or only after PCIe moves -> escalate for riser/cable inspection
4) if repro across slots -> RMA

Maria: I'll capture driver + kernel logs and attach to RT-2026-298. Also exporting nv-hostengine traces.

Akshay: Starting lab replication now. ETA 4h for initial attempt. Will report buttoned-up repro steps or mark as nondet.

Devin: Thanks team. Keep messages short in-thread. If you find a blocking repro, call pager. :rotating_light:

Akshay: Update 3h later — replicated Xid 79 on bench after 1h 10m under memrw with riser B. Swapped to riser A = no repro after 3h. Looks riser-adjacent.

Maria: Noted. I'll schedule bench RMA flow and attach logs. We should also document PCIe reseat SOP in infra playbooks.

Janet Ops: Approved RMA. Please set lifecycle flag `hold_for_rma` and estimate replacement date in RT-2026-298.

Devin: Closing loop: moving node to bench pool, updating incident RT-2026-298 with test matrix. Will reopen here if anything unexpected.

sre-bot: gcu-node-42 state changed -> quarantined_for_rma. Ticket RT-2026-298 updated with attachments.

Maria: small note: add a short `pcie-sanity` test to pre-return checks so we catch riser-related flakes earlier.

Devin: Agreed — will PR to infra playbooks with `pcie-sanity` and `memrw-quick` checks. :white_check_mark:
